summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is dominated by a few key platforms serving distinct needs, from community-driven model sharing to production-grade inference APIs. Hugging Face remains the central hub with over 2 million models, while platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and AWS Bedrock serve specialized deployment, local inference, and enterprise needs. The ecosystem is highly concentrated, with the top 0.01% of models accounting for nearly half of all downloads, and Qwen derivatives, DeepSeek, and Llama-based models driving the majority of community activity.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central community hub for discovering, sharing, and deploying open-source AI models, datasets, and demos across virtually every AI domain
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and basic inference; PRO plan ~$9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour based on hardware selected
features: Largest open-source model repository with 2M+ models
Inference Providers tier routing to partners like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra
Spaces for hosting interactive ML demos and apps
Dataset and model versioning with Git-based workflow
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain tools
Supports gguf, lerobot, mlx, and 464%+ growth in gguf library repositories in 2026
Top 200 models account for 49.6% of all downloads
Cumulative Llama downloads reached 476 million by March 2026 on platform
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations seeking the broadest model selection, community collaboration, and a one-stop shop for the full ML lifecycle from discovery to deployment

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that allows users to download and run open-source LLMs entirely on their own hardware with a simple CLI and API interface
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models optimized for local inference
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs limited to user's own hardware
features: One-command model download and execution on local machines
Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows
Compatible with Apple Silicon via Metal and CUDA for NVIDIA GPUs
OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy integration
Supports popular model families including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Gemma
Modelfile system for customizing and creating model variants
Growing ecosystem of GUI frontends like Open WebUI
No data leaves the user's machine, ensuring full privacy
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without cloud costs or data exposure, and those building offline-capable AI applications

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform providing a simple pay-per-second API to run thousands of open-source models without managing infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second based on compute used; no upfront costs; pricing varies by model and hardware (e.g., CPU from ~$0.0001/sec, A100 GPU from ~$0.0016/sec); free tier with limited credits
features: Access to 50,000+ open-source models via a unified API
Serverless GPU execution with automatic scaling
Supports image, video, audio, and language models
Cog open-source tool for packaging and deploying custom models
Deployments feature for low-latency dedicated endpoints
Webhooks and streaming support
Simple REST API compatible with most programming languages
Community model sharing and versioning
platforms.best_for: Developers and indie hackers who want the simplest possible API to experiment with or productize open-source models without any infrastructure management

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance, low-cost LLM inference platform offering an OpenAI-compatible API for open-source models, plus fine-tuning and training capabilities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token inference pricing among the lowest in the market (e.g., Llama models from ~$0.10-$0.18 per million tokens); fine-tuning priced per GPU hour; free $1 credit on signup
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement in existing workflows
Consistently ranked lowest or near-lowest cost for LLM inference in 2026
Supports top models including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more
Dedicated endpoints for production deployments
Fine-tuning API with support for LoRA and full fine-tuning
Together Custom Models for training from scratch
High throughput with low latency optimized inference stack
Listed as a routing partner in Hugging Face's Inference Providers tier
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and startups building production LLM applications who want the best price-to-performance ratio with an easy OpenAI-compatible migration path

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Production-grade inference platform specializing in fast, scalable deployment of open-source LLMs and multimodal models with an OpenAI-compatible API
platforms.model_count: 50+ optimized open-source models with support for custom model deployment
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with competitive rates (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.10 per million tokens); serverless and dedicated deployment options; volume discounts available
features: Industry-leading inference speed with proprietary optimization techniques
OpenAI and Anthropic compatible APIs
FireAttention custom CUDA kernels for high throughput
Supports text, vision, and audio models
Function calling and JSON mode support
Serverless and on-demand dedicated GPU deployments
Compound AI system support for multi-model workflows
Listed among top five value AI model hosting platforms for 2026
Listed as a routing partner in Hugging Face's Inference Providers tier
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and developers requiring high-throughput, low-latency production inference for open-source models with strong reliability SLAs and advanced API features

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed enterprise cloud service for accessing and deploying foundation models from leading AI providers within the AWS ecosystem with built-in security and compliance
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI, Amazon Nova, and more
platforms.pricing: On-demand pay-per-token pricing varying by model (e.g., Claude Sonnet ~$3 input/$15 output per million tokens); Provisioned Throughput for committed capacity at hourly rates; no upfront infrastructure costs
features: Access to top proprietary and open-source models via a single AWS API
Native integration with AWS services including S3, Lambda, SageMaker, and IAM
Agents for Bedrock enabling multi-step agentic workflows
Knowledge Bases with RAG support using AWS-managed vector stores
Guardrails for content filtering and responsible AI controls
Model Evaluation for benchmarking and comparing models
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training for supported models
Enterprise-grade security, VPC support, and compliance certifications
Appears in 37.6% of AI-adopting cloud environments alongside gpt-4o according to cloud security research
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need production-ready, secure, and compliant AI deployments with minimal infrastructure management and access to both proprietary and open-source frontier models
